name: income-niches
question: In small professional niches that already pay for software, which repeated manual chores or missing tools could a two-person team sell as a self-serve product (web tool, app, extension, template, data product)?
system_extra: Prefer narrow professional groups over mass consumers: broad consumer gaps (invoices, fax, scanners, photo cleaners, shuffle, tuners) were all crowded in two earlier runs. Strong signals: people doing a task by hand every week, using spreadsheets or copy-paste as a workaround, paying a freelancer for something repetitive, or naming a price. Favour products that can run on assets the team already pays for: Claude API credit (near-zero AI cost), automated video rendering, SEO content pipeline, Telegram alert engine, Discogs/Spotify/YouTube APIs. Skip anything needing client services or a sales team. Already checked and crowded, do NOT return these or close variants: property-manager/landlord tools (rent, COI, inspections, deadlines, owner reports, leases), bookkeeping PDF/statement extraction, Etsy profit tracking, podcast analytics, playlist-curator analytics, footage/drive catalogs, post-production paperwork, stem QC, wedding venue blog generators, invoicing apps, fax/scan, duplicate photo cleaners, shuffle, guitar tuners, mileage trackers, faceless video builders, Shorts clippers, Reddit intent monitors.
